failure_cases.interpretation: Every interior peak is selected at the first point allowed by the two-sample derivative-edge exclusion.
Downsampling moves peak position and increases measured lead, so lead distance is not resolution invariant.
The global scan starts with a failed solve and cannot define an upper collapse boundary or precursor curve.
The held-out PEGASE-9241 scan has no converged prefix; the historical pattern is not testable under V1.
Earlier scaling lines used random fallback arrays, added drift/noise, or reused designed trigger functions; those outputs are not canonical evidence for this reconstruction.
